newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanshin Const to seek court protection.
newsitem.headline: Hanshin Const to seek court protection.

text.p: South Korea's Hanshin Construction Co has decided to file for court receivership due to increasing debt, an official at the Korea Stock Exchange said on Friday.
The official said a Hanshin executive told him by telephone on Friday that the company would soon announce the decision.
"An executive of Hanshin Construction told us by telephone that the application would be filed today or tomorrow," said the Korea Stock Exchange official, who declined to be named.
Hanshin's executives were not immediately available for comment, and a company official told Reuters he had heard from executives about the decision.
The Korea Stock Exchange official said trading in Hanshin shares would be suspended from Saturday if Hanshin officially announces the decision before Saturday's session begins.
Hanshin shares closed Friday's trading at 3,560 won, up 40 won on the day.
